name: requirements-changed
description: When requirements.md is saved, ask the agent to carry the change into design.md and tasks.md before touching code.

then.prompt: requirements.md just changed. 1) List the acceptance criteria that changed (compare with git diff). 2) Update every value in design.md that repeats them (tables, component notes, the Testing Strategy table, correctness properties). 3) Reopen the tasks in tasks.md whose _Requirements_ lines name a changed criterion, and add tasks for new criteria. 4) Name the code blocks in out/index.html that implement them. Do not edit out/index.html in this step. Do not change any test's expected value unless the requirement it validates changed.
